verdict.rationale: Retell documents its concurrency model: Pay-As-You-Go workspaces get a default quota of 20 concurrent calls, a configurable reserved_inbound_concurrency setting stops outbound traffic from crowding out inbound calls, and analytics dashboards track concurrency. Nothing in the pack shows how to raise the limit beyond the default, so the second half of the story (scaling to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity requests) is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented self-serve way to raise concurrency, published limits above the default tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of behavior at scale.
